generated_by: Frozen final-paper input export; source hashes retained below.
role: frozen inputs for the TRACE number reproduction
path_policy: Host paths replaced by provenance labels. Validate the release using python scripts/verify_release.py from repository root.
staging: run_all.py applies inputs/frozen/* to generated/ before running, so generated/ holds the frozen inputs plus fresh outputs. The lists below separate the two.

inputs.name: counterfactual_inputs.json
inputs.note: eight-model frozen export; all three panels (baseline/global_rms/phase_scrambled) are read by build_attribution_numbers + build_revision_numbers

inputs.name: repair_inputs.json
inputs.note: three-model re-paired-background export; read by build_repair_numbers, build_category_structure and build_utility_numbers

inputs.name: ten_model_panel.json
inputs.note: ten-model panel. Only panels.baseline (build_robust_numbers) and the model lists (build_category_structure) are read, so global_rms and phase_scrambled are not shipped. All ten models are retained - see check_model_filter.py

inputs.name: view_energies.json
inputs.note: per-view stem RMS for the 3456 probe conditions; read by build_probe_numbers

inputs.name: subst_aggregates.json
inputs.note: sufficient statistics for the target-substitution panel; read by build_subst_numbers. Only pooled counters ship: the per-unit target arms are not needed for any reported statistic, which is the documented boundary of this analysis

inputs.name: fixed_panel.json
inputs.note: present arm, ten models x 192 questions; read by build_matched_numbers and by build_utility_numbers for ground-truth y_present

inputs.name: absent_inputs.jsonl
inputs.note: absent arm, ten models x 512 conditions; read by build_matched_numbers

inputs.name: absent_manifest.jsonl
inputs.note: ground truth for the 512 absent conditions; read by build_matched_numbers

inputs.name: position_bias.json
inputs.note: answer-key asymmetry and the degeneracy flags behind the clean-model set; read by build_robust_numbers

inputs.name: counterfactual_interface_inputs.json
inputs.note: fixed-mixture query-swap panel, eight models x 64 tuples x 3 roles x 4 wordings x 2 mappings; read by build_counterfactual_interface

inputs.name: case_audio_creak/full.wav
inputs.note: frozen rendered views of one measured mixture, used by Fig. 1(a)

inputs.name: case_audio_creak/remove_target.wav
inputs.note: frozen rendered views of one measured mixture, used by Fig. 1(a)

inputs.name: case_audio_creak/remove_off_1.wav
inputs.note: frozen rendered views of one measured mixture, used by Fig. 1(a)

notes: probe_boot.json is deliberately NOT shipped: its producer is outside the reproduction set, so its bootstrap intervals cannot be re-derived here. build_probe_numbers.py recomputes the oracle/shortcut/loudness point estimates (0% / 100% / 45.0%) instead.
No LaTeX is compiled and no model inference is run by this analysis.
